extra_quotes: To investigate the structural reconstruction of the twisted interface, we developed a machine learning potential (MLP) based on density functional theory (DFT) calculations (see Methods) and performed molecular dynamics (MD) simulations.

A series of SrTiO3 (STO) films with controlled thicknesses (15, 20, 25 unit cell thickness (u.c.)) were grown by molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) [35,36] on approximately 3.5 u.c. water-soluble Sr4Al2O7 sacrificial layers deposited on STO (001) substrates.
